newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian bourse rises, volume up.
newsitem.headline: Estonian bourse rises, volume up.

text.p: The Estonian bourse index rose on Thursday and activity picked up after a sluggish week, dealers said.
Overall market volume was almost 7 million kroons compared to just over 3 million kroons on Wednesday, and the index maintained its steady rise, increasing by 0.09 percent to 96.53.
Union Bank was the market's most active listing at over 1.8 million kroons and its price closed at 23.45 kroons compoared with 23.35 kroons on Wednesday.
